title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mountain Winery, Saratoga | 2008
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mountain Winery in Saratoga, California, USA, on 24 July 2008.

It was the 22nd show by the tenth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 29 dates between June and August 2008.

Starr had previously performed at the Mountain Winery on 14 and 15 June 2000. He returned there on 3 August 2010, 17 July 2012, and 24 May 2024.

The tenth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
